basic_info.description: Discover this charming top-floor flat in the vibrant Mission District, offering a traditional and welcoming layout. This home features 3 generous bedrooms and a large, sunlit eat-in kitchen that's ideal for hosting gatherings. The cozy living room invites relaxation, while a versatile nook can easily serve as a home office or library. Enjoy your own artsy, outdoor space in the backyard perfect for entertaining, gardening, or unwinding. Unit A includes its own dedicated backyard area and a private covered deck. Additionally, you'll find a semi finished attic that offers extra storage or future living space.  Situated just one or two blocks from a wealth of excellent restaurants, shops, grocery stores, coffee shops, and public transit, with freeway access only a few blocks away, this TIC flat boasts a 98 Walk Score offering both comfort and convenience in a prime location. Near SF General and St. Luke's hospital. 3rd bedroom can be office or possibly build 2nd bathroom.  Garage parking can be purchased for an additional amount.
